description: This information source consolidates communication-network performance indicators, definitions and target values from SNS-JU projects. The working group explicitly connects the indicators to common testing, collection procedures and validation methods. The source therefore supports defining comparable network simulation and trial objectives. It contains proposed targets and do not represent measured achieved performance. The native descriptor is a PDF white paper; exact metric names, numeric values and machine-readable tables are not asserted from the abstract. Geographic and temporal coverage describe the contributing programme context, not a validated representative sample of deployed networks. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. The deposited documents or data declare CC BY 4.0 and public access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain bounded to explicitly named tests or locations, with other fields unknown. Only metadata was inspected, without reading measurements, archives, source code or document bodies. Related project reports may overlap; independent sample counts and equivalent test conditions are not assumed. This supports the source-defined communication system performance simulation role.
name: 6G KPIs - Definitions and Target Values
